subject: Mathematics
source_note: TIE (2023), Mathematics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

sub_topics.title: Use numerical skills in different contexts
competences: (a) Explain the basic concepts of Mathematics (Meaning of mathematics, branches of mathematics, relationship between mathematics and other subjects, importance of mathematics)
(b) Explain the concept of rational, irrational, and real numbers
(b) Convert repeating/ recurring decimals into fractions and vice versa
(c) Represent rational numbers on a number line
(d) Explain the concept of inequalities and absolute values of real numbers
(e) Describe the importance of numbers in real-life situations

objectives.text: (a) Explain the basic concepts of Mathematics (Meaning of mathematics, branches of mathematics, relationship between mathematics and other subjects, importance of mathematics)
objectives.resources: Charts of relationships between mathematics and other fields, real life objects, Math Games and Apps, Educational channels
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic concept of mathematics are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Explain the concept of rational, irrational, and real numbers
objectives.resources: Calculator, Charts of real numbers, ruler, tape measure, graph papers, number line chart
objectives.assessment_criteria: Rational, irrational, and real numbers are well explained

objectives.text: (b) Convert repeating/ recurring decimals into fractions and vice versa
objectives.resources: Calculator, Charts of real numbers, ruler, tape measure, graph papers
objectives.assessment_criteria: Repeating/ recurring decimals are correctly converted into fractions

objectives.text: (c) Represent rational numbers on a number line
objectives.assessment_criteria: Rational numbers are well represented on the number line

objectives.text: (d) Explain the concept of inequalities and absolute values of real numbers
objectives.assessment_criteria: Absolute values and inequalities in real numbers are properly determined

objectives.text: (e) Describe the importance of numbers in real-life situations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Importance of numbers are well described

sub_topics.title: Use ratios and proportions in daily life
competences: (a) Explain the concept of ratios and proportions
(b) Solve ratio and proportion problems

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept of ratios and proportions
objectives.resources: Money, charts of real-life scenarios, interest calculators, and games real objects, and bank statements
objectives.assessment_criteria: Ratios and proportions are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Solve ratio and proportion problems
objectives.resources: Calculator, Charts of real numbers, ruler, tape measure, graph papers, number line chart
objectives.assessment_criteria: Problems on ratios and proportions are correctly solved

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in geometry and algebra

sub_topics.title: Use geometry, approximations, relations and functions in various contexts
competences: (a) Explain the concept of approximations (rounding off, significant figures, and decimal places)
(b) Round off numbers and estimate values of expressions
(c) Approximate numbers to the required significant figures and decimal places
(d) Use approximations in computations and measurements of quantities in various contexts

objectives.text: (a) Explain the concept of approximations (rounding off, significant figures, and decimal places)
objectives.resources: Charts of a number line, estimation jars, estimation games and applications
objectives.assessment_criteria: Approximations are clearly explained

objectives.text: (b) Round off numbers and estimate values of expressions
objectives.assessment_criteria: Numbers are rounded off and values of expressions are correctly estimated

objectives.text: (c) Approximate numbers to the required significant figures and decimal places
objectives.assessment_criteria: Numbers are approximated to required significant figures and decimal places correctly

objectives.text: (d) Use approximations in computations and measurements of quantities in various contexts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Approximations are correctly applied in computations and measurements.

sub_topics.title: Use algebra and matrices in problem solving
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of algebra (algebraic expressions and equations, linear simultaneous equations of two unknowns, inequalities in one unknown)
(b) Use algebraic expressions to model situations (word problems into algebraic expressions and equations)
(c) Solve simultaneous equations using substitution and elimination methods
(d) Solve inequalities in one unknown

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of algebra (algebraic expressions and equations, linear simultaneous equations of two unknowns, inequalities in one unknown)
objectives.resources: Beam balance, mathematical software such as MATLAB, and GeoGebra, real objects, Algebra animations
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of algebra are correctly explored

objectives.text: (b) Use algebraic expressions to model situations (word problems into algebraic expressions and equations)
objectives.resources: Beam balance, mathematical software such as MATLAB, and GeoGebra, real objects, Algebra animations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Algebraic expressions are applied to model situations correctly

objectives.text: (c) Solve simultaneous equations using substitution and elimination methods
objectives.assessment_criteria: Simultaneous linear equations are solved correctly

objectives.text: (d) Solve inequalities in one unknown
objectives.resources: Number line chart, graphing calculator, real objects
objectives.assessment_criteria: Inequalities are solved properly

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts in coordinate geometry, trigonometry, circles, vectors, probability and statistics

sub_topics.title: Use basic coordinate geometry, trigonometry and vectors skills in daily life
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of coordinate geometry (gradient and equations of a straight line, graphs of linear equations)
(b) Find the gradient/ slope of a line
(c) Determine the equation of a straight line and draw its graph
(d) Solve linear simultaneous equations graphically
(e) Use mathematical software to solve and draw graphs of simultaneous equations

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of coordinate geometry (gradient and equations of a straight line, graphs of linear equations)
objectives.resources: Mathematical software such as MATLAB, and GeoGebra, Maple, Mathematica, graph papers
objectives.assessment_criteria: Basic tenets of coordinate geometry are explored

objectives.text: (b) Find the gradient/ slope of a line
objectives.assessment_criteria: Gradient of line is found properly

objectives.text: (c) Determine the equation of a straight line and draw its graph
objectives.assessment_criteria: Equation of straight line is determined and its graph is properly drawn

objectives.text: (d) Solve linear simultaneous equations graphically
objectives.assessment_criteria: Simultaneous equations are correctly solved graphically

objectives.text: (e) Use mathematical software to solve and draw graphs of simultaneous equations
objectives.assessment_criteria: Simultaneous equations are solved and drawn correctly
